name: @sdlc-workflow/sunflower-view
description: Build, tests and hooks of the sdlc-workflow plugin.

scripts.version: node scripts/stamp-version.mjs && npm run build && npm run verify:versions && git add -- .claude-plugin/plugin.json .codex-plugin/plugin.json package-lock.json docs/site/nav.html dist ../../.claude-plugin/marketplace.json

comment:dependencies: Runtime deps are EMPTY by design — every Claude-invoked entrypoint ships pre-bundled under dist/ (npm run build, esbuild). A fresh install needs no runtime `npm install`. The libs below are devDependencies: bundled into dist/ and imported by tests, never installed at a user's runtime. See docs/internal/archived/SELF-CONTAINED-BUILD-PLAN.md.
comment:hosts: ONE tree serves both hosts (SINGLE-SOURCE-PLAN): Claude Code reads .claude-plugin/plugin.json + hooks/hooks.json; Codex reads .codex-plugin/plugin.json + hooks/codex.hooks.json (declared hooks replace hooks/hooks.json discovery). Skill prose is host-neutral — verify:neutrality enforces the §3.3 budget; verify:versions keeps the two manifests, package.json, and both root catalogs on one version; verify:deployment is the machine-side Codex doctor.
